0022600107.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-0, 1st in the Southeast and 1st in the East) host the Houston Rockets (2-0, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) in the Hawks' third game of the season, and Atlanta has yet to play at home this year. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Houston is missing Fred VanVleet (knee) and Steven Adams (ankle), and Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hawks lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026.
